name: Uriah
summary: A Hittite and one of David's mighty men, the husband of Bathsheba. David had him placed where the fighting was fiercest so that he would be killed.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Go Home
key_moments.description: David called Uriah home from the war and urged him to go down to his house. Uriah would not, since the ark and the army were living in tents, and he slept at the door of the king's house.

key_moments.title: Sent to the Front and Killed
key_moments.description: David sent Uriah back with a letter telling Joab to set him at the front of the fiercest battle and then pull back from him. Uriah was killed in the fighting.
